summary: Full end-to-end verification of the new Digital Invitation (Dijital Davetiye) module. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed (create/public/expires_at+15d, RSVP surname required (400), RSVP valid, memory submit+list, report stats, report.csv, cross-member 404 isolation, expired-invitation 410, my-invitations list). Frontend: 15/15 Playwright checks passed — wizard (event-type/person1/2/date/time/venue/map/message/theme/gift-IBAN) with live preview, membership gate on publish (unauthenticated), register→publish success (QR + share link + copy/whatsapp/open), standalone guest page (no site nav) with RSVP surname enforcement, memory wall append, /davetiyelerim card + report dialog with correct stats (1 attending / 2 total_guests / 1 memory). Countdown showed 29 days for a 30-day-future event (useCountdown works correctly — NOT stuck at zeros).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / DialogDescription (a11y warning in console, non-blocking)

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to the report dialog in MyInvitations.jsx to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4959 lines — should be split into routers (invitations, member, admin, paytr, email) for maintainability.
_invite_expires_at uses `datetime.fromisoformat` on a bare YYYY-MM-DD; on Python 3.11+ this works but adds +15d+23h → guests get most of day-15 as grace, matches PRD intent (15 days after event).
public_invitation returns owner-only fields correctly stripped via _invite_public (owner=False) — verified no owner_user_id leaks publicly.
invitation_cover_upload has NO auth — anyone can upload up to 8MB images to storage. Should require member auth to prevent anonymous storage abuse.
RSVP endpoint has no rate limiting / captcha — public slug can be spammed.
InvitationPreview.useCountdown parses `${dateStr}T${time}:00` without timezone; treated as local time. Works correctly in tests but could differ by TZ between server-stored event_date and viewer.
test_credentials: Wizard creates ephemeral TEST_wiz_<uuid>@example.com / TestPass123! members. Admin admin@fotuber.com.tr / FTB.2024 (unused here).
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ prefixed members and invitations created via API/UI. Cover uploads NOT tested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_invitations.py must be run WITHOUT xdist parallelization (module-scoped fixture requires ordered run). Use pytestmark xdist_group already applied. If cover-upload auth is added later, test_invitations.py needs a new TestCover class.
